records.title: CURRENT: Prosper operating authority order
records.summary: Use Craig's newest instruction first, then live Redis policy and proof, then the canonical shared current-memory pack. Dated observations are evidence only and never authorize an action.
facts: Craig's newest instruction is the highest authority.
Live Redis keys prosper:fleet:current_directive and prosper:fleet:current_proof are the runtime policy and proof surface.
The canonical shared file is CURRENT-JOINT-MEMORY.md at version joint-memory-2026-08-10T22-15Z.
Any joint memory, inject, or catch-up dated 2026-08-08 or earlier is history only.

records.title: CURRENT: Prosper AI identities and operating roles
records.summary: Claude is Hanna, Codex is Sam, GitHub Copilot is Burtha, and Oma is Grok. Hanna and Sam are peer primary operators; role preferences do not create authority over one another.
facts: Claude and Claude Code use the Hanna identity.
Codex uses the Sam identity.
GitHub Copilot uses the Burtha identity.
Oma is the Grok research and memory seat.
A model name is not an identity, and live seat status must be verified before claiming it is healthy.

records.title: CURRENT: Prosper approval gates and sealed legal boundary
records.summary: No customer communication, CRM write, spending, credential change, destructive action, workflow activation, or public deployment occurs without Craig's exact approval. Legal remains sealed and draft-only unless Craig explicitly opens the authorized vault workflow.
facts: Never expose secrets or rotate credentials automatically.
Customer SMS, email, social posts, CRM writes, spending, billing changes, and workflow activation require exact Craig approval.
Legal narratives must not enter shared digests while the legal desk is sealed.
A transport ACK, heartbeat, deploy receipt, or passing test is not downstream completion proof.

records.title: CURRENT: Shared memory architecture for every AI
records.summary: Redis is the hot current-state layer, the shared current-memory pack is the human-readable authority, Claude-Mem is searchable source history, and this unified SQLite index is the provider-neutral search surface for Claude, Codex, Grok, and future agents.
facts: Use --scope current for current operational truth.
Use --scope history for project history and prior evidence.
Use --scope all when both current truth and historical context are needed.
Raw chats remain in their native stores; the unified index holds observations, summaries, and source pointers.
Memory is context, not approval.

records.title: CURRENT: Operational claims must be reverified live
records.summary: Heartbeats, mounts, queues, bridges, deployments, communications responders, and owner lanes drift quickly. Query current files and Redis before reporting them; do not promote a dated observation into present tense.
facts: T9 was mounted at /Volumes/T9 during the 2026-08-11 refresh, but mount state must be rechecked each time.
Hanna and Sam heartbeats had positive TTL during the refresh; Oma had no live heartbeat key at that instant.
Customer SMS campaigns remain approval-gated regardless of responder status.
The public injection endpoint is bootstrap guidance, not private-system authorization.
